name: asc-workflow
activation: `command -v asc` succeeds, `asc auth status --validate` passes, and the user confirms a paid Apple Developer Program account.
prerequisites: A paid Apple Developer Program account.
The asc CLI, jq and a trusted .asc/workflow.json file.
risks: Runs shell commands from .asc/workflow.json, and its examples bake --confirm into stage, review submit and publish --submit; approve the file before running a workflow with submit or --confirm steps.
